name: commitcost
description: Tie cloud cost changes to the commits that caused them.

scripts.seed: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run db:push && tsx cli/src/index.ts seed
scripts.demo: npm run demo:check && npm run dev -w @commitcost/web
scripts.demo:check: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run db:push && tsx cli/src/index.ts demo
scripts.sync: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run db:push && tsx cli/src/index.ts sync
scripts.analyze: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npm run db:push && tsx cli/src/index.ts analyze
